description: A delivery harness for Claude Code: each task runs as a fixed list of steps, and warden itself runs the checks, the review and the fixes.
rules: Follow the loop: run `warden next`, act on its `status`, hand in with `warden done --json '<one line of JSON>'`.
Never run the checks to prove a step; the engine runs them on the exact commit.
Never push, open a pull request or merge outside the ship step.
`warden approve`, `warden retry` and `warden reset` are for a person; ask the user to type `approve` or `retry`.
A project's own tools live in `.warden/tools/` (index.ts barrel, roles.json); run them with `warden tools <name|role>`.
When a command is refused with a `warden:` message, read the whole message and do not work around it; load the `/warden:guide` skill.
